answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a $30 non-refundable entry tax, burned at registration, before it can trade. A trusted kernel of auditors spot-checks 5% of newcomers each epoch; a fake caught twice loses its deposit, its sponsor pays double. The cost ripples outward: 1,000 fakes burn $30,000 plus $5,000 in audit fees against a $3,000 pool share, a guaranteed loss. An honest agent pays $30 once and keeps its full share over a long horizon.
